environment.description: Ktor service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). pgBouncer running in transaction pooling mode on port 6432 with `disable_prepared_statements = false` (default). No application-layer filtering on inbound HTTP. Container runs with default seccomp profile. The service account `app_service` has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE privileges on all tables in the `public` schema.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no HTTP inspection)
config.network: VPC with service in private subnet, NLB in public subnet
